scope: standalone bounded native input framing and six fixed synthetic parser containers
observed_container_assertions: exact maximum opaque script/request lengths and digests, stdin EOF and exit0
reject truncated, trailing, wrong-version, oversize-length and mismatched-digest data with exit2
effective network none, nonroot UID/GID, read-only root and single parser module mount
cap-drop ALL, no-new-privileges, pids16, memory64MiB, CPU0.25 and core0
exact owned name/purpose/ID cleanup and subsequent absence
